name: The Milan System for Reporting Salivary Gland Cytopathology (MSRSGC)
specimen: Major and minor salivary gland FNA
use: FNA of major (parotid, submandibular, sublingual) and minor salivary glands and periparotid/submandibular masses.
not_use: Cervical lymph nodes outside the gland (use Sydney/WHO LN).
report_structure: Ancillary tests (IHC/FISH e.g. PLAG1, MYB, MAML2, NR4A3, pan-TRK)

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: Specimen adequate if it contains enough lesional material to answer the clinical question.
Guide: a minimum of ~60 lesional cells in solid lesions (2nd ed); matrix alone (e.g. chondromyxoid) may be diagnostic.
Mucinous cyst fluid is not ND (→ AUS); any atypia is not ND.
ROSE and US guidance reduce ND rates.

categories.name: Non-diagnostic
categories.definition: Insufficient cellular material for a cytological diagnosis.

rom.source: Milan 2nd ed (Rossi et al., Cancer Cytopathol 2024, doi 10.1002/cncy.22753, Table 1)

categories.management: Clinical and radiological correlation; repeat FNA (US-guided ± ROSE) or core biopsy.
criteria: Fewer than 60 lesional cells (2nd ed guidance) in a solid lesion, with no matrix/specific findings.
Poor preservation, obscuring blood/artefact.
Non-mucinous cyst fluid with only macrophages/no epithelium.
Exception: any atypia → not ND; mucinous cyst fluid → AUS (not ND).

diagnoses.name: Non-diagnostic – insufficient cellularity
diagnoses.final: Non-diagnostic (Milan Category I). Insufficient lesional cells for diagnosis.
diagnoses.comment: Repeat ultrasound-guided FNA or core biopsy if clinically indicated.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System I – Non-diagnostic

diagnoses.name: Non-diagnostic – non-mucinous cyst contents only
diagnoses.final: Non-diagnostic (Milan Category I). Non-mucinous cyst contents with macrophages only.
diagnoses.comment: Correlate with imaging; repeat FNA of any solid component.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System I – Non-diagnostic

diagnoses.name: Non-diagnostic – normal salivary elements only (lesion not sampled)
diagnoses.final: Non-diagnostic (Milan Category I). Normal salivary gland elements only in the setting of a discrete mass.
diagnoses.comment: May not represent the lesion; repeat image-guided FNA recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System I – Non-diagnostic

categories.name: Non-neoplastic
categories.definition: Benign non-neoplastic processes: inflammatory, reactive, cystic, infectious.

rom.source: Milan 2nd ed (Rossi et al., Cancer Cytopathol 2024, doi 10.1002/cncy.22753, Table 1)

criteria: Sialadenitis (acute/chronic/granulomatous), sialadenosis, reactive lymph node, benign cysts (lymphoepithelial cyst).
Normal salivary elements with no discrete mass clinically.

diagnoses.name: Chronic sialadenitis
diagnoses.final: Non-neoplastic (Milan Category II). Chronic sialadenitis.
diagnoses.comment: Scant acinar cells, ductal groups, lymphocytes and fibrous fragments. Clinical follow-up.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System II – Non-neoplastic

diagnoses.name: Acute sialadenitis / abscess
diagnoses.final: Non-neoplastic (Milan Category II). Acute sialadenitis.
diagnoses.comment: Neutrophils and debris; culture recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System II – Non-neoplastic

diagnoses.name: Granulomatous sialadenitis (TB, sarcoidosis, duct obstruction)
diagnoses.final: Non-neoplastic (Milan Category II). Granulomatous sialadenitis.
diagnoses.comment: ZN stain/CBNAAT recommended to exclude tuberculosis.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System II – Non-neoplastic

diagnoses.name: Sialadenosis
diagnoses.final: Non-neoplastic (Milan Category II). Consistent with sialadenosis in the appropriate clinical setting.
diagnoses.comment: Enlarged acinar cells; associated with diabetes, alcohol, malnutrition, bulimia.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System II – Non-neoplastic

diagnoses.name: Reactive intraparotid lymph node
diagnoses.final: Non-neoplastic (Milan Category II). Reactive lymphoid hyperplasia (intraparotid lymph node).
diagnoses.comment: Polymorphous lymphoid cells; if monotonous, flow cytometry to exclude lymphoma.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System II – Non-neoplastic

diagnoses.name: Lymphoepithelial cyst (incl. HIV-associated)
diagnoses.final: Non-neoplastic (Milan Category II). Consistent with lymphoepithelial cyst.
diagnoses.comment: Squames, lymphocytes and cyst debris; HIV testing if multiple/bilateral. Exclude Warthin tumour and cystic SCC metastasis.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System II – Non-neoplastic

diagnoses.name: IgG4-related / chronic sclerosing sialadenitis (Küttner)
diagnoses.final: Non-neoplastic (Milan Category II). Chronic sclerosing sialadenitis.
diagnoses.comment: Serum IgG4 and histology for confirmation.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System II – Non-neoplastic

diagnoses.name: Sjögren / lymphoepithelial sialadenitis
diagnoses.final: Non-neoplastic (Milan Category II). Lymphoepithelial sialadenitis.
diagnoses.comment: Risk of MALT lymphoma; flow cytometry if a monotonous population is present.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System II – Non-neoplastic

categories.name: Atypia of undetermined significance (AUS)
categories.definition: Indeterminate lesion where neoplasm cannot be excluded; mostly reactive/metaplastic atypia or poorly sampled neoplasm.

rom.source: Milan 2nd ed (Rossi et al., Cancer Cytopathol 2024, doi 10.1002/cncy.22753, Table 1)

categories.management: Repeat FNA (± ancillary) or surgery; lab AUS rate ideally <10%.
criteria: Reactive/repair atypia or squamous/oncocytic metaplasia raising neoplasm.
Mucinous cyst contents with scant/no epithelium (low-grade MEC not excluded).
Scant aspirate with features suggestive but not diagnostic of neoplasm.
Atypical lymphoid population with insufficient material for flow.

diagnoses.name: AUS – mucinous cyst contents
diagnoses.final: Atypia of undetermined significance (Milan Category III). Mucinous cyst contents with scant epithelial cells.
diagnoses.comment: Low-grade mucoepidermoid carcinoma cannot be excluded; repeat FNA of solid area/surgery and MAML2 testing if material allows.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System III – AUS

diagnoses.name: AUS – oncocytic/squamous metaplastic atypia
diagnoses.final: Atypia of undetermined significance (Milan Category III). Atypical oncocytic/squamous metaplastic cells.
diagnoses.comment: Differential includes Warthin tumour with metaplasia, oncocytoma and neoplasm; repeat FNA suggested.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System III – AUS

diagnoses.name: AUS – atypical lymphoid cells
diagnoses.final: Atypia of undetermined significance (Milan Category III). Atypical lymphoid cells.
diagnoses.comment: Repeat FNA with flow cytometry.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System III – AUS

diagnoses.name: AUS – scant basaloid/epithelial cells
diagnoses.final: Atypia of undetermined significance (Milan Category III). Scant atypical epithelial cells.
diagnoses.comment: Neoplasm cannot be excluded; repeat FNA or excision recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System III – AUS

categories.name: Neoplasm: Benign
categories.definition: Benign neoplasm diagnosed on well-established cytological criteria.

rom.source: Milan 2nd ed (Rossi et al., Cancer Cytopathol 2024, doi 10.1002/cncy.22753, Table 1)

categories.management: Surgery (conservative excision) or clinical follow-up in selected patients.
criteria: Pleomorphic adenoma: fibrillary chondromyxoid matrix (magenta on MGG) with embedded plasmacytoid/spindle myoepithelial cells.
Warthin tumour: oncocytic sheets, lymphocytes, granular/'dirty' proteinaceous background.
Lipoma, schwannoma, haemangioma, others with classic features.

diagnoses.name: Pleomorphic adenoma
diagnoses.final: Neoplasm: Benign (Milan Category IVA). Pleomorphic adenoma.
diagnoses.comment: Fibrillary chondromyxoid stroma with myoepithelial and ductal cells. Surgical excision recommended (risk of recurrence and rare malignant transformation).
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVA – Benign neoplasm

diagnoses.name: Warthin tumour
diagnoses.final: Neoplasm: Benign (Milan Category IVA). Warthin tumour.
diagnoses.comment: Flat sheets of oncocytic cells, background lymphocytes and granular cyst debris. Conservative management or excision according to clinical setting.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVA – Benign neoplasm

diagnoses.name: Lipoma
diagnoses.final: Neoplasm: Benign (Milan Category IVA). Lipoma.
diagnoses.comment: Mature adipocytes, concordant with imaging.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVA – Benign neoplasm

diagnoses.name: Schwannoma
diagnoses.final: Neoplasm: Benign (Milan Category IVA). Schwannoma.
diagnoses.comment: Spindle cells with wavy nuclei, Verocay-like fibrillary fragments; S100/SOX10+.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVA – Benign neoplasm

diagnoses.name: Haemangioma / lymphangioma
diagnoses.final: Neoplasm: Benign (Milan Category IVA). Vascular lesion consistent with haemangioma.
diagnoses.comment: Correlate with imaging.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVA – Benign neoplasm

diagnoses.name: Oncocytoma (classic, with clinical/imaging support)
diagnoses.final: Neoplasm: Benign (Milan Category IVA) – oncocytic neoplasm favouring oncocytoma; or classify as SUMP (IVB) if uncertain.
diagnoses.comment: Pure oncocytic aspirate; differential with Warthin, oncocytic MEC and acinic cell carcinoma.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVA/IVB

categories.name: Neoplasm: Salivary gland neoplasm of uncertain malignant potential (SUMP)
categories.definition: Neoplasm in which a benign neoplasm cannot be distinguished from a malignant one (e.g. cellular basaloid, oncocytic/oncocytoid, clear cell, atypical pleomorphic adenoma patterns).

rom.source: Milan 2nd ed (Rossi et al., Cancer Cytopathol 2024, doi 10.1002/cncy.22753, Table 1)

criteria: Cellular basaloid neoplasm (basal cell adenoma vs adenoid cystic, basal cell adenocarcinoma, cellular PA).
Cellular oncocytic/oncocytoid neoplasm (oncocytoma vs MEC vs acinic cell/secretory carcinoma).
Clear cell neoplasm; cellular myoepithelial neoplasm; PA with atypical features.
Use subtyping descriptors and give differential diagnosis.

diagnoses.name: SUMP – basaloid neoplasm
diagnoses.final: Salivary gland neoplasm of uncertain malignant potential (Milan Category IVB) – basaloid neoplasm.
diagnoses.comment: Differential includes basal cell adenoma, cellular pleomorphic adenoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma and basal cell adenocarcinoma. MYB/PLAG1/HMGA2/β-catenin studies may help; excision recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVB – SUMP

diagnoses.name: SUMP – oncocytic/oncocytoid neoplasm
diagnoses.final: Salivary gland neoplasm of uncertain malignant potential (Milan Category IVB) – oncocytic/oncocytoid neoplasm.
diagnoses.comment: Differential: oncocytoma, Warthin, oncocytic MEC, acinic cell and secretory carcinoma. Excision recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVB – SUMP

diagnoses.name: SUMP – clear cell neoplasm
diagnoses.final: Salivary gland neoplasm of uncertain malignant potential (Milan Category IVB) – clear cell neoplasm.
diagnoses.comment: Differential includes myoepithelial neoplasm, clear cell carcinoma, epithelial-myoepithelial carcinoma and metastatic RCC.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVB – SUMP

diagnoses.name: SUMP – myoepithelial neoplasm / cellular pleomorphic adenoma with atypia
diagnoses.final: Salivary gland neoplasm of uncertain malignant potential (Milan Category IVB) – myoepithelial-rich neoplasm.
diagnoses.comment: Myoepithelioma vs myoepithelial carcinoma; excision recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System IVB – SUMP

categories.name: Suspicious for malignancy
categories.definition: Features highly suggestive of malignancy but not definitive.

rom.source: Milan 2nd ed (Rossi et al., Cancer Cytopathol 2024, doi 10.1002/cncy.22753, Table 1)

categories.management: Surgical excision; frozen section may help extent.
criteria: Atypical cells suspicious for high-grade carcinoma but scant/obscured.
Suspicious for specific types (e.g. adenoid cystic, MEC, lymphoma).

diagnoses.name: Suspicious for malignancy – carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Suspicious for malignancy (Milan Category V). Suspicious for carcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: Surgery recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System V – Suspicious

diagnoses.name: Suspicious – adenoid cystic carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Suspicious for malignancy (Milan Category V). Suspicious for adenoid cystic carcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: Basaloid cells with hyaline globules; MYB IHC/FISH can support.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System V – Suspicious

diagnoses.name: Suspicious – lymphoma
diagnoses.final: Suspicious for malignancy (Milan Category V). Suspicious for lymphoma.
diagnoses.comment: Flow cytometry/biopsy.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System V – Suspicious

categories.name: Malignant
categories.definition: Malignancy diagnosed; specify type and grade (2nd ed: low-grade vs high-grade).

rom.source: Milan 2nd ed (Rossi et al., Cancer Cytopathol 2024, doi 10.1002/cncy.22753, Table 1)

categories.management: Surgery ± neck dissection/adjuvant per grade; lymphoma/metastasis: oncology.
criteria: Low-grade: acinic cell, secretory, low-grade MEC, polymorphous adenocarcinoma, epithelial-myoepithelial, basal cell adenocarcinoma, intercalated duct-type.
High-grade: salivary duct carcinoma, high-grade MEC, adenoid cystic (solid), carcinoma ex PA, myoepithelial carcinoma (high-grade), SCC, lymphoepithelial carcinoma, metastases.

diagnoses.name: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma, low grade
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – low-grade carcinoma: mucoepidermoid carcinoma, low grade.
diagnoses.comment: Mucin, mucocytes, intermediate and squamoid cells; MAML2 rearrangement supports.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (low grade)

diagnoses.name: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma, high grade
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – high-grade carcinoma: mucoepidermoid carcinoma, high grade.
diagnoses.comment: High-grade MEC overlaps with salivary duct carcinoma and metastatic SCC; mucocytes may be scant. MAML2 rearrangement supports MEC. Classify as 'high-grade carcinoma' if subtyping not possible.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (high grade)

diagnoses.name: Acinic cell carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – low-grade carcinoma: acinic cell carcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: Acinar cells with granular/vacuolated cytoplasm, lack of ducts/fat; NR4A3 IHC +, DOG1+.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (low grade)

diagnoses.name: Secretory carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – low-grade carcinoma: secretory carcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: Vacuolated cells, mammaglobin/S100+, ETV6::NTRK3 fusion (pan-TRK IHC).
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (low grade)

diagnoses.name: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – adenoid cystic carcinoma (grade by solid component).
diagnoses.comment: Basaloid cells around hyaline globules; MYB::NFIB fusion.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Polymorphous adenocarcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – low-grade carcinoma: polymorphous adenocarcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: Mostly minor glands; PRKD1 alterations.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (low grade)

diagnoses.name: Epithelial-myoepithelial carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – low-grade carcinoma: epithelial-myoepithelial carcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: Biphasic: inner ductal (CK7+) and outer clear myoepithelial (p63/SOX10+) cells, often with basement-membrane hyaline globules; overlaps with pleomorphic adenoma and adenoid cystic carcinoma. Often low-grade; subtype confirmation on histology.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (low grade)

diagnoses.name: Salivary duct carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – high-grade carcinoma: salivary duct carcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: Apocrine high-grade cells, necrosis; AR+, HER2 testing recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (high grade)

diagnoses.name: Carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma.
diagnoses.comment: Malignant component with residual PA matrix.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Myoepithelial carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – myoepithelial carcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: Cytologically monotonous myoepithelial cells cannot be separated from myoepithelioma on FNA unless overt atypia/necrosis; diagnosis rests on invasion at histology – consider SUMP if atypia is mild.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Basal cell adenocarcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – low-grade carcinoma: basal cell adenocarcinoma (usually requires histology; often SUMP on FNA).
diagnoses.comment: Basaloid cells with basement-membrane material indistinguishable from basal cell adenoma on cytology (invasion needed); usually reported as basaloid neoplasm, SUMP, unless clear malignant features.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (low grade)

diagnoses.name: Squamous cell carcinoma (usually metastatic)
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – squamous cell carcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: Primary salivary SCC is rare; exclude metastasis from skin/head and neck.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (high grade)

diagnoses.name: Lymphoma (MALT, DLBCL, etc.)
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
diagnoses.comment: Flow cytometry/IHC.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Metastatic malignancy (melanoma, SCC skin, others)
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – metastatic [type].
diagnoses.comment: Intraparotid node metastases (cutaneous SCC, melanoma of head and neck) are common in older patients; correlate with skin cancer history; IHC (p40, SOX10/HMB45) on cell block.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Carcinoma, NOS / poorly differentiated
diagnoses.final: Malignant (Milan Category VI) – high-grade carcinoma, NOS.
diagnoses.comment: Use when malignant epithelial cells cannot be subtyped; exclude metastasis (lung, skin) and lymphoma; AR/GATA3/HER2 help for salivary duct carcinoma.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: Milan System VI – Malignant (high grade)

references: Faquin WC, Rossi ED, et al. (eds). The Milan System for Reporting Salivary Gland Cytopathology. 2nd ed. Springer, 2023.
WHO Classification of Tumours Editorial Board. Head and Neck Tumours. 5th ed. IARC, 2022.
